page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m1 server family. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, this instance is provisioned with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. It features 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated resource allocation.

This server configuration does not include bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators. The underlying CPU architecture lacks advanced instruction set extensions such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES-NI), which limits its suitability for specialized vector math or high-throughput encryption tasks.

Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for hosting standard web servers, microservices, development environments, and low-traffic database instances that do not demand high-performance local storage or specialized CPU instructions. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable compute performance for baseline workloads without the performance variability of shared-core or burstable instances.
